Name: Shared mailbox report
Description: Lists shared mailboxes with their Sent Items settings (keep a copy of mail sent as / on behalf of the mailbox) and counts how many users have Full Access, Send As, Send on Behalf and Inbox/Calendar folder permissions. Groups are expanded to their members, so the counts are effective users. Tick 'Detail' for one row per user and permission. Read-only.
Author: Admin Toolkit

Parameters.Name: Mailboxes
Parameters.Label: Mailboxes
Parameters.HelpText: One UPN, alias or email address per line, e.g. sales@contoso.example. Leave empty if 'All shared mailboxes' is ticked.

Parameters.Name: AllSharedMailboxes
Parameters.Label: Scope
Parameters.HelpText: All shared mailboxes (ignores the list above)

Parameters.Name: IncludeFolderPermissions
Parameters.Label: Folder permissions
Parameters.HelpText: Include Inbox and Calendar folder permissions. Untick for a faster run on large tenants.

Parameters.Name: Detail
Parameters.Label: Detail
Parameters.HelpText: One row per mailbox, user and permission instead of one summary row per mailbox.
